displayName: semper: licence device-lock mismatches above __DEVLOCK_MISMATCHES_PER_LICENCE_PER_HOUR__ an hour

documentation.content: One licence dropped to Demo at the device lock (stage mismatch: not the locked device) more than __DEVLOCK_MISMATCHES_PER_LICENCE_PER_HOUR__ times in an hour (the licenseId label names it): a key shared across devices, or a release that lost its device identity. Runbook: ops/monitoring/README.md#devlock-mismatch
